title: crypto2dev: AWS CI integration (TEST_CRYPTO2DEV=1)
description: Execute a first full TEST_CRYPTO2DEV=1 run of tests/ci/test-on-aws.sh against the crypto2dev shim once the shim implementation and simulator are complete. Track: (1) which test phases pass and which skip (expected: shim tests skip until wolfssl-d2j scaffold is merged), (2) any unexpected failures in the build chain (wolfcrypt.ko + crypto2dev.ko + wolfSSL userspace rebuild), (3) clean module load/unload with no kernel BUG or Oops, (4) document the exact aws-profile and instance type used. Once all shim issues are closed, promote this to a matrix run: Ubuntu 22.04 + Ubuntu 24.04 as the baseline.
notes: Run command: TEST_CRYPTO2DEV=1 TEST_LINUXKM=1 ./tests/ci/test-on-aws.sh <aws-profile>. Expected first run: wolfcrypt.ko builds and loads, crypto2dev.ko builds and loads, --enable-crypto2dev configure flag not yet present (wolfssl-d2j), shim tests skipped. Goal is a clean infrastructure run with no crashes.
